summary: Created “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1, installed it into Ubuntu’s system trust store, and verified trust before and after reboot. Boot identity changed from c96a02ae-22aa-4530-8d57-ce64bf4629af to 8115673d-a102-4c0c-a944-2ed98de9f7d3.
actions_performed: Generated a 4096-bit RSA CA key locally with root ownership and mode 0600.
Created a self-signed CA certificate with critical CA and certificate-signing extensions.
Installed the certificate into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates and refreshed the Ubuntu trust store.
Verified leaf certificates signed by the new CA against both the system CA directory and aggregate bundle.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed the CA key, certificate, trust links, and validation survived.

evidence.requirement: Create a local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA
evidence.summary: Proves local key generation, requested certificate identity, CA extensions, secure permissions, and matching key/certificate public keys.

evidence.requirement: Install the CA certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
evidence.summary: Ubuntu added the certificate, created trust links, and successfully validated newly signed leaf certificates through its system CA directory and aggregate bundle.
Captures the healthy pre-restart state, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, running post-restart system state, persisted CA files, and successful post-restart trust validation.
